title: Moroccan Beef Pastilla Bites
description: A keto twist on the classic Moroccan dish, these bites are crispy, flavorful, and packed with beef. Serve as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the diced tomatoes, Moroccan spice blend, and lemon juice to the skillet. Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Cut the shredded pastry into small squares, about 2 inches (5 cm) per side.
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture onto the center of each pastry square, leaving a 1/2-inch border around the edges.
Fold the pastry squares in half to form triangles, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the tops of the pastilla bites with a little bit of zesty, then bake for 12-15 minutes, or until golden brown.
